name: gardener
description: Plant care assistant with watering reminders and health checkups
author: Hermes Agent

cron.name: gardener_daily_reminders
cron.description: Send daily plant care reminders at 18:00 Warsaw time

cron.name: gardener_monthly_checkups
cron.description: Monthly plant health checkup requests on the 1st of each month

env_vars.name: GARDENER_DB_URL
env_vars.description: PostgreSQL connection string for the gardener database

env_vars.name: GARDENER_S3_ENDPOINT
env_vars.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL (MinIO, AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, ...). Leave blank for AWS S3 default. Legacy alias: GARDENER_MINIO_ENDPOINT.

env_vars.name: GARDENER_S3_ACCESS_KEY
env_vars.description: S3 access key. Legacy alias: GARDENER_MINIO_ACCESS_KEY.

env_vars.name: GARDENER_S3_SECRET_KEY
env_vars.description: S3 secret key. Legacy alias: GARDENER_MINIO_SECRET_KEY.

env_vars.name: GARDENER_S3_BUCKET
env_vars.description: S3 bucket name for plant photos. Legacy alias: GARDENER_MINIO_BUCKET.

env_vars.name: GARDENER_S3_REGION
env_vars.description: S3 region. Use 'us-east-1' for MinIO and Cloudflare R2; set appropriately for AWS S3.

env_vars.name: PLANTNET_API_KEY
env_vars.description: Pl@ntNet API key — primary plant identification service (free tier: 500 req/day). Sign up at https://my.plantnet.org
